mechanism: Cefepime may impair renal function, potentially increasing dapagliflozin exposure and increasing risk of genital infections and euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA).
action: Monitor renal function and blood glucose; counsel patient on euDKA symptoms (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, dyspnea); consider temporary dapagliflozin interruption if significant renal deterioration occurs.
